Two hospital systems have been selected to receive this year's national quality award, which recognizes organizations that demonstrate excellence in performance and leadership. The recipients were chosen following a rigorous review process that included an independent evaluation by a panel of experts and site visits to each organization. Judges assessed applicants in seven categories, including leadership, strategy, customer focus, workforce engagement, and results. "These organizations show that sustained improvement is possible even in demanding environments," said the program director. The awards will be presented at a ceremony in the spring. Since the program began in 1987, only a small fraction of applicants have received the honor. Both winners will share their practices with other organizations through conferences and published case studies.
